claim: Patchline's db-semantics report emits deterministic query-plan regression preflight checks for representative workloads around index and column changes without fabricating measured EXPLAIN costs. The gate proves index creation yields before/after qualitative workloads that must be confirmed by native plans, index removal is treated as a regression risk until dropped-index coverage and hot-query evidence are supplied, column type or drop changes produce workload-specific regression obligations, and a plain ADD COLUMN control stays quiet.
real_repo: synthetic-from-real public migration patterns: PostgreSQL concurrent indexes, MySQL DROP INDEX ON table, and PostgreSQL ALTER COLUMN / DROP COLUMN migrations

cases.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_accounts_status ON accounts(status, created_at);
ALTER TABLE accounts ALTER COLUMN status TYPE varchar(64);
ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN legacy_status;
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN status text;
